steps: OS=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); ARCH=$(uname -m); if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then ARCH="x64"; elif [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then ARCH="arm64"; fi; if [ "$OS" = "darwin" ]; then OS="darwin"; else OS="linux"; fi; curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v20.11.1/node-v20.11.1-$OS-$ARCH.tar.gz" -o node.tar.gz
